parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description: The accelerated domain name. You can specify only one domain name in each request.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Valid values: an integer from **1** to **1000**.

parameters.name: SearchKeyword
parameters.description: The keyword that is used to query the certificate.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cdn describe-cdn-ssl-certificate-list --domain-name www.example.com --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --search-keyword certabc --region cn-hangzhou
